priceSnapshot.note: THE RECLAIM FAILED OVERNIGHT AND ENDDAY'S REDUCE LINE FIRED. Endday published at 64,558.9 and named 64,371.0 - the daily ema50 - as the one line that mattered, with a resting stop recommended at 64,340.0. Both were reached. The 02:00Z hourly bar settled 64,351.7, the first settled close below the ema50, and every hourly close since has been lower: 64,328.5, 64,316.1, 64,238.1. Price then ran a 68,352 dollar long-liquidation flush between 06:53Z and 07:12Z into a low of 64,165.8 - 174.2 points below the recommended stop - before bouncing 119.4 points to 64,285.2. changePct is the rolling 24-hour move against the 64,199.3 close of the 18 Aug 06:00Z bar and is POSITIVE at plus 0.13 percent, which is the least useful number on this page: against endday's snapshot price is 273.7 points lower (minus 0.42 percent) and against the 64,727.8 UTC daily open it is 442.6 points lower (minus 0.68 percent).

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close back above $64,364.8 - the daily ema50, recomputed this run from 200 OKX index dailies. Reclaiming it on a settled close is what would say the overnight flush was a liquidity raid rather than a trend change, and only then does the rest of the dry powder go to work. Until then this is a market trading under an average it failed at four times in five sessions.

decisionBox.changed: MATERIALLY, AND IN THE DIRECTION ENDDAY WARNED ABOUT. Endday said REDUCE, named 64,371.0, and recommended a resting stop at 64,340.0; both fired and the wallet had already trimmed twelve percent of the spot leg the session before. That call is now spent - you do not re-reduce into a level that has already been taken. This desk flips to a small ADD for one specific reason: the thing it has been waiting for finally happened. 68,352 dollars of long liquidations cleared between 06:53Z and 07:12Z, the biggest single fill being 25 contracts at 64,167.1, and price is already 119.4 points back above the low with the last two prints in the feed being SHORT liquidations at 64,306.6 and 64,332.6. A stop is no longer recommended because the level it would protect has already been visited and the position it would protect has already been reduced; the next report is only about 4.8 hours away rather than overnight.

liquidation.note: MEASURED AND THE LARGEST CONCENTRATION IN THE FEED. calibration.note: The prior report is 2026-08-18-endday, published at 19:52:00-05:00 with spot at 64,558.9. IT WAS RIGHT, AND IT WAS RIGHT ON THE MECHANISM IT SPECIFIED. Endday said REDUCE, named 64,371.0 as the one line that mattered, required a settled 1H close through it, and recommended a resting stop at 64,340.0 - the first stop this file has recommended. The 02:00Z hourly bar settled 64,351.7 and the four hourly closes after it were all lower. The stop level was traded through by 174.2 points at the 64,165.8 low. Its add gate at 64,896.0 was never approached; the highest print since publication is 64,584.5, some 311.5 points short. Two secondary calls also landed. Endday wrote that the correlation debt from QQQ's minus 1.69 percent close was likely to be collected in the Asia session, and it was - BTC fell 273.7 points overnight while JPXN turned out to have closed minus 2.58 percent. It also predicted a 300-500 point drift into 64,042.2 on nobody's volume rather than a cascade; the actual move was 393.1 points top to bottom on the session and stopped 123.6 points short of the target. The one thing it got wrong is the direction of open interest: endday read falling OI as constructive de-leveraging, and OI has since risen 1.46 percent into a falling price, which is fresh short positioning. The trade grades yes. Endday sold 0.00039313 BTC at 64,558.9 for 25.38 USDT; that BTC is worth 24.28 at 64,285.2, so the trim saved 1.08 USDT of markdown - the first time in five sessions this desk's sizing has been large enough for the saving to be visible rather than rounding error.
